description: This file implements system notification handling for an Android app, including classes and functions to create, post, and manage notifications, with support for different importance levels, permissions, and JSON parsing.

classes.name: SystemNotifyRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a notification request with title, body, sound, and priority.

classes.name: SystemNotificationPoster
classes.description: Interface defining methods to check authorization and post notifications.

classes.name: AndroidSystemNotificationPoster
classes.description: Implementation of SystemNotificationPoster that uses Android notification APIs.

classes.name: SystemHandler
classes.description: Main class handling incoming notification requests, parsing JSON params, and delegating posting.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to post notifications.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Creates and posts a notification based on the request parameters.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Ensures the notification channel exists for the specified priority.

methods.name: compatPriority
methods.description: Maps priority string to NotificationCompat priority constant.

methods.name: isSilentSound
methods.description: Determines if the sound setting indicates a silent notification.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify
methods.description: Main entry point to handle a system notification request from JSON string.

methods.name: parseNotifyRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a SystemNotifyRequest object.

methods.name: parseParamsObject
methods.description: Parses JSON string to a JsonObject.
